name: Seaweed spaghetti and sesame salad with tahini dressing
intro: This is lovely as it is, for a light lunch or starter, or served alongside some sticky

ingredients.item: large English cucumber, halved lengthwise, seeds scooped out, and
flesh cut into long, thin strips (2½ cups/250g)
tbsp/20g white or black sesame seeds, or a mixture of both, lightly toasted
crushed red pepper flakes (or nanami togarashi, if you have it)

method: To make the dressing, put the honey, vinegar, mirin, mustard, soy sauce, tahini, and peanut oil in a small bowl, whisk well to combine, then set aside.

Put the seaweed spaghetti into a medium saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then decrease to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes, until al dente. Drain, refresh under cold running water, pat dry, and set aside. Place in a large bowl, along with the cucumber, sesame seeds, cilantro, dressing, and ½ tsp of salt. Mix together, then divide among the bowls (or arrange in a large serving bowl), sprinkle with chile flakes and serve at once.
